finding.summary: FoG outer evaluation context used every observable candidate, but inner OOF prediction, responder-training context, CAGE channel-scale fitting, and HERA physics-reference fitting used annotation-eligible windows only.
finding.scientific_effect: The learned HERA participant-context population, CAGE context-feature scale, and HERA physics-reference threshold were annotation-selected and mismatched to the intended inference population.

affected_checkpoint_entries.allowed_use: historical reconstruction and validity-regression evidence only

historical_parity_witness.allowed_use: exact historical witness for unaffected-method parity only; never promotion
historical_parity_witness.schema_normalization_scope: only the enumerated v4 governance/audit additions in the correction protocol; all scientific signal/grid/identity fields remain exact

correction.inner_prediction_population: all candidates of each inner-held-out participant
correction.responder_training_context_population: all candidates of every outer-training participant
correction.context_feature_scale_fit_population: all candidates of every outer-training participant
correction.physics_reference_fit_population: all candidates of every outer-training participant, with only the signal-derived minimum-valid-pair-fraction rule applied internally
correction.outer_evaluation_context_population: all candidates of every outer-held-out participant
correction.zero_supervision_participant_rule: retain candidates in context; exclude the signature only from label-dependent utility/router fitting and report it

replacement_rule: A replacement must launch from a clean commit, bind external-har-publication-v4 and the context-training protocol, record complete inner and outer candidate populations plus the physics-reference fit population and threshold, retain predictions, and pass artifact plus split validation.
